verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a dedicated API tokens help article, and JMAP uses standard OAuth 2.0 or Bearer tokens. A community user reports app passwords can be restricted to SMTP-only access, which is concrete evidence of least-privilege credentials. However, the pack shows only the title of the API tokens article, so nothing confirms that API tokens themselves can be scoped (for example read-only or per-capability) for an agent. Missing for 10: documented per-scope or read-only permissions for API tokens, OAuth scope details, token expiry and revocation controls, and independent hands-on corroboration of scoped agent credentials.
